summary: Keep the governance surface small and stateless.
title: Prefer narrow gates

summary: 治理核心轻量化大重构完成：三 Gate + 轻量 SQLite + JSONL 单写者 Memory + disposable worktree；Dogfood 四案例通过后定稿 1.0.0。
title: Governance-core 1.0.0 定稿

summary: 清理判断必须解析实际目标并检查跟踪文件、保护路径和链接；cwd 位于临时区不证明目标可删除。Codex 判断任务归属，AIOS 的允许不等于宿主执行策略批准。
title: 目标检查与宿主权限分层

summary: 未知数据库不能被自动当作旧版重建。显式迁移须先取得包含 WAL 的一致性备份；Memory 接受失败保留候选，只有全字段完全一致的已合入记录可安全清理。
title: 失败时保留事实与恢复线索

summary: Keep UUID progress and atomic results in checkout-local ignored adapter storage. Core gates derive current facts; cancelled or disconnected commands stop their owned process tree and cannot resume in the background. Historical status is never a permission cache.
title: Finish records diagnose calls without caching Gate permission

summary: Real MCP cancellation tests exposed a Windows delete-sharing race while polling run records. Bound the replacement retry; persistent persistence failure must stop owned commands and must not produce a completed decision. Native MCP cancellation is explicitly bridged to the execution thread.
title: Windows concurrent readers can temporarily block atomic replacement

summary: A live MCP process does not prove that one Finish request is still executing after a terminal storage failure. Version 2 records hold a UUID file lock during the call. Status probes existing locks read-only and rereads terminal results before returning interrupted; old running records without invocation evidence remain unverifiable.
title: Finish invocation liveness requires its own lock

summary: Git assume-unchanged and skip-worktree can hide modified dependency content from diff. Prove each candidate using actual working files and pinned blob identities, enumerate ignored directory additions, and refuse provenance when external filters would be needed. Other patched paths do not invalidate an unchanged file.
title: Index cleanliness cannot prove upstream file content

summary: Synthetic repositories and internal pytest links in a task-owned system-temp container were rejected as user assets. Cleanup now distinguishes an independent container from a checkout, refuses current-checkout ancestors and external links or Git associations, scans without following links, and retains a shared five-second budget. Ownership and host trust remain native Codex responsibilities.
title: Disposable fixture containers require containment checks instead of basename bans
